#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;

    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> odd(n);
    if (a[0] % 2 == 1)
        odd[0] = 1;
    else
        odd[0] = -1;

    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 1)
            odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + 1;
        else
            odd[i] = odd[i - 1] - 1;
    }

    vector<int> price(n - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        price[i] = abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]);
    }

    vector<int> prices;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (odd[i] == 0) {
            prices.push_back(price[i]);
        }
    }

    sort(prices.begin(), prices.end());

    int ans = 0;
    for (int p : prices) {
        if (b - p >= 0) {
            b -= p;
            ++ans;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
